field_trip_permission: Most schools require signed permission slips returned before the trip date. Students without signed forms typically cannot attend and will remain at school with an alternative assignment.
immunization_reminder: State law requires students to be up-to-date on vaccinations to attend school. Free or low-cost vaccines are often available through county health departments.
fee_notice: Many schools offer fee waivers or reduced-cost options for families who qualify for free/reduced lunch programs. Ask the school office about financial assistance.
attendance_warning: Schools are required to notify parents when absences reach certain thresholds. Excessive unexcused absences can trigger truancy proceedings. Contact the school to discuss any attendance issues.
lunch_program: The National School Lunch Program provides free or reduced-price meals to qualifying families. Applications are available at the school office or online through the district website.
meeting_invitation: Parent-teacher conferences are typically 15-20 minutes. Bring any questions about your child's progress. Translation services are usually available if requested in advance.
behavior_letter: Behavior notices require a parent signature to confirm receipt. If you disagree with the report, you can request a meeting with the teacher or counselor to discuss it.
photo_consent: Photo consent forms control whether your child's image can be used in yearbooks, school websites, newsletters, or media. You can typically opt out without any negative consequences.
schedule_change: School schedule changes (early dismissal, delays) may affect bus routes and after-school care. Check with your transportation and childcare providers when schedules change.
fundraising: Participation in school fundraisers is always voluntary. There is never an obligation to sell or purchase items.
